blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — The city government of Candon has allocated P124 million for agricultural assistance to tobacco farmers, including the provision of farm inputs, fuel support and improvements to tobacco-curing facilities. The assistance was distributed during the Candon City Tobacco Enhancement Program held on Monday, Nov. 9, at the Candon City Sports Complex, with farmers from the city’s 42 barangays taking part. The program, led by Mayor Eric Singson, covers the distribution of fertilizers and insecticides, diesel or fuel assistance, flue-curing barns, and financial assistance for the repair of existing curing facilities.
